    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

- The surviving registrant from the 2017 merger, Southern National Bancorp of Virginia,

  terms of Sonabank's core banking business and its equity-method investment in Southern
  Trust Mortgage, LLC; the filing does not identify a separate reportable segment, line
  of business, or financial disclosure attributable to the former EVB/Eastern Virginia
  Bankshares operations. [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-003093, Form 10-K]

  I," described as an unconsolidated subsidiary holding trust-preferred securities
  financing — an accounting/financing vehicle, not a disclosed operating business or
  segment. [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-003093, Form 10-K]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable
- No press or other secondary source describing a distinct post-2017 trajectory for the
  acquired EVB branch network, customers, or personnel (separate from the surviving
  registrant's consolidated results) was located. [UNVERIFIED]

- Because Eastern Virginia Bankshares, Inc. was absorbed into another registrant through
  a whole-company merger and deregistered its securities within weeks of the June 2017
  closing, and because the surviving registrant's subsequent public filings report its
  business on a consolidated, single-segment basis with no separate disclosure of the
  formerly acquired business's financial or operating trajectory, there is no traceable
  public 3-5-year outcome record specific to the acquired business. [SRC: SEC accession 0001144204-17-036155, Form 15-12G] [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-003093, Form 10-K]

[SLICE END]
